channel.title: Violations Watch: Syria
channel.description: New incidents reported in Syria. Most entries are unverified leads, not findings.

item.title: Landmine explodes as a family car passes near Hayyan, northern Aleppo, killing a child and wounding his father (Anadolu, citing Alikhbariah)
item.description: Unverified lead (High priority). Hayyan, Aleppo Governorate, Syria. Types: Killing of civilians. Alleged perpetrator: Explosive remnant of war; Syrian state channel Alikhbariah attributes the mine to the ousted Assad government (via Anadolu). Reported casualties: 1 killed, 1 injured. Grave violations against children: Killing and maiming. Disputed or caveats: Single wire report (Anadolu citing Syrian state TV Alikhbariah); mine attribution unverified. 1 source. Original reports and legal frameworks: https://violationswatch.org/#VW-2026-2706
